checks.name: negative_control_untransformed_tip
checks.detail: control (-m, +lambda) with the UNtransformed tip theta = 0 (b(-L) = 0) in all 210 states: it is not the T3 image. The density profile alone, max_y |n_control - n_plus| / max_y |n_plus|, is at least 4.750e+00 (N8_lamm1_a15) in every state with a control state (with -m and the untransformed tip the k = 0 zero modes (e^(-m y), 0) are localised at the tip instead of the brane); the combined measure (max of that, the globally sorted (eps, degeneracy) list, E_KS and the EMT integrals) is at least 7.200e+01 (N8_lamm1_a00_T10; its level part 7.200e+01 is dominated by the shifted degeneracies, its scalar part is 4.4e-16 in N8_lam0_a00, where E_KS and the EMT integrals vanish for both); required > 1e-06, in the 196 states where the solver found a self-consistent control state; in 14 states (N8_lamm1_a10, N8_lamm2_a05, N8_lamm2_a10, N8_lamm2_a15, N8_lamm2_a20, N136_lamm1_a15, N136_lamm2_a15, N136_lamm2_a20, N688_lamm1_a20, N688_lamm2_a15, N8_lamm1_a00_T20, N8_lamm1_a05_T10, N8_lamm1_a10_T10, N8_lamm1_a10_T20) the solver found none (SCF diverging, also in its coupling continuation; reason of the first: exit 1: error: direct: SCF diverging at iteration 70 (residual 8.429008787015489e2, best 7.898698729764037e-1); continuation at 0.25: SCF not converged in 800 iterations (last residual 1.0419118898605), which separates them from the converged T3 image as well (it does not show that no such state exists)
